text: Ah, ladies and gentlemen, a most warm welcome to Ye Grand Internet Service Company—where modern marvels meet the finest customer care! If you'll kindly lend me your ear: Should your internet be on the fritz, press 1, and we shall mend it with haste! If your bill requires settling, press 2, for we do so appreciate a prompt patron. Craving unparalleled speed? Press 3, and we shall equip you with the swiftest connection of the age! Wishing to speak with a live representative? Press 0, and we shall connect you without delay! We thank you for your time and patronage—may your browsing be ever smooth and your signals ever strong! Ta-ta for now!
